studies.dataset: Bitstamp BTC/USD spot, Kaggle v706 normalized by ff137
studies.finding: In the 2020–2024 replay, momentum’s net Sharpe fell below passive BTC/cash near 0.3071× base costs. Terminal wealth crossed near 0.4781×. Each multiplier scales both the 50 bp fee and 10 bp adverse slippage per fill.
studies.next_action: Inspect the completed weekly cadence comparison to see how reducing turnover changed both exposure and net outcomes.
studies.question: At what fee and slippage levels does the historical momentum comparison change sign?

studies.dataset: Bitstamp BTC/USD spot, Kaggle v706 normalized by ff137
studies.finding: Weekly cut fills from 188 to 80. At base costs its net Sharpe was 0.081 higher than daily momentum and 0.261 lower than passive BTC/cash. Both paired 95% intervals include zero. The accounts held different positions on 292 daily closes.
studies.next_action: Use the position-day counts and gross and net comparisons to examine how the slower schedule changed timing and exposure.
studies.question: Did acting only on the completed Sunday close improve momentum’s net performance after costs?
studies.title: Weekly BTC momentum decisions
